label: president or manager office in
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or public body Y.
scope_notes: Manager paths dominate, preserving the earlier president-plus-manager scope. Explicit manager or president roles and historical tenure qualify. Coach, director, chair, researcher, athlete and ordinary employment alone do not establish this narrower office.

facts.reason: Bobby Cox is explicitly Braves manager and directly manages them; lineup and other actions are additional evidence.
Neil Smith is repeatedly Rangers manager, with a further president-of description. Both roles fall within the declared scope.
Dave Johnson is explicitly Mets manager and the dismissal path identifies that same office, which supports historical tenure.
Several direct manager-of/with and possessive descriptions establish Omar Minaya as Mets manager; operation-chief and assistant paths add roles.
Joe Torre is explicitly Yankees manager. Contract, leadership and speech paths are additional evidence rather than the basis of this office judgment.
